features.name: SysTick
features.desc: Cortex-M core timer — ISR-driven ms tick for non-blocking delays and RTOS scheduling. SDK currently uses a busy-wait loop.

features.name: fault handlers
features.desc: HardFault / BusFault / UsageFault handlers with register-dump diagnostics.

features.name: MSI / MSIS (low-power)
features.desc: Multi-Speed Internal oscillator — variable-frequency RC used as the default boot clock and in low-power modes.

features.name: MCO (clock output)
features.desc: Master Clock Output — routes an internal clock to a GPIO pin for external measurement or as a clock source to another IC.

features.name: EXTI (external interrupts)
features.desc: Triggers a callback on rising, falling, or both edges of a GPIO pin without polling.

features.name: alternate function config
features.desc: Routes a pin to a peripheral (UART TX, I2C SDA, SPI CLK, etc.) rather than software-controlled GPIO.

features.name: open-drain / pull config
features.desc: Open-drain output mode and internal pull-up / pull-down resistor configuration.

features.name: hardware flow control
features.desc: RTS / CTS handshaking — prevents buffer overruns on high-speed or high-latency links.

features.name: LPUART (low-power)
features.desc: Low-power UART variant that keeps running in STOP mode and can wake the MCU on incoming data.

features.name: fast-mode plus (1 MHz)
features.desc: Requires stronger 20 mA GPIO drivers and a compatible kernel clock. Not all cores support it.

features.name: 10-bit addressing
features.desc: Extends the I2C address space from 128 to 1024 devices on a single bus.

features.name: SMBus mode
features.desc: I2C superset used by PMICs and fuel gauges — adds PEC error checking and bus timeout requirements.

features.name: slave mode
features.desc: Core acts as the secondary SPI device, clocked and selected by an external master.

features.name: OctoSPI / QSPI
features.desc: High-speed memory interface with 4 or 8 parallel data lines — used for NOR flash and PSRAM tile access.

features.name: input capture
features.desc: Measures timing of external signals — pulse width, frequency, or phase of an incoming waveform.

features.name: one-shot pulse
features.desc: Generates a single precisely-timed pulse on a GPIO pin, triggered by software or a hardware event.

features.name: encoder mode
features.desc: Counts quadrature encoder pulses directly in hardware for position or velocity measurement.

features.name: LPTIM (low-power timer)
features.desc: Continues running in STOP mode — used for periodic wakeup and low-power event scheduling.

features.name: IWDG (watchdog)
features.desc: Independent Watchdog — resets the MCU if firmware stops refreshing it, guarding against hangs.

features.name: millivolt read (VREFINT)
features.desc: Converts raw counts to millivolts using the factory-calibrated VREFINT reference.

features.name: temperature sensor
features.desc: Reads the on-die temperature sensor channel using the factory calibration points.

features.name: continuous / scan mode
features.desc: ADC free-runs through a sequence of channels, continuously updating results in a buffer.

features.name: analog watchdog
features.desc: Triggers an interrupt when a conversion result crosses a configured high or low voltage threshold.

features.name: oversampling / burst
features.desc: Averages multiple conversions in hardware to increase effective resolution and reduce noise.

features.name: ADC (pad-centric API)
features.desc: Use pad numbers from project.json directly — channel mapping is resolved automatically from the board definition.

features.name: GPIO (pad-centric API)
features.desc: Read / write pads by number rather than port + pin; direction and AF resolved from the project.

features.name: UART (pad-centric API)
features.desc: Open a UART by specifying TX/RX pad numbers; peripheral and AF resolved automatically.

features.name: SPI (pad-centric API)
features.desc: Configure SPI by pad numbers; peripheral selection and CS management handled by the TAL.

features.name: PWM (pad-centric API)
features.desc: Output PWM on any timer-capable pad by number; timer and channel resolved from the board definition.

features.name: GPIO pad auto-init
features.desc: Generates GPIO init code in core_init.c for all pads assigned in project.json.

features.name: I2C auto-init
features.desc: Generates I2C peripheral init, kernel clock selection, and pull-up config from project.json.

features.name: analog pad init
features.desc: Sets ADC-assigned pads to analog input mode (MODER=11) to prevent digital noise on ADC inputs.

features.name: sleep mode
features.desc: CPU halted, peripherals running — lowest-latency wakeup (~1 µs). Ideal for interrupt-driven designs.

features.name: STOP mode
features.desc: CPU and most clocks halted, RAM retained — wakeup from EXTI or timer (~5 µs).

features.name: standby / shutdown
features.desc: Near-zero power draw — RAM is lost and wakeup triggers a full reset.

features.name: RTC wakeup
features.desc: Wake from STOP or Standby on a timed RTC alarm.

features.name: EXTI wakeup
features.desc: Wake from STOP or Standby on a GPIO edge — e.g. button press or tile interrupt line.

features.name: hardware RNG
features.desc: True Random Number Generator — hardware entropy source for cryptographic keys and nonces.

features.name: AES (hardware)
features.desc: Hardware AES-128/256 accelerator — faster and more power-efficient than software crypto.

features.name: PKA / ECC
features.desc: Public Key Accelerator — hardware elliptic-curve math for BLE pairing (ECDH) and certificate operations.

features.name: HASH (SHA-256)
features.desc: Hardware SHA-256 / HMAC accelerator for message authentication and integrity checks.

features.name: USB CDC serial
features.desc: Emulates a virtual COM port over USB — appears as a serial device on the host OS.

features.name: USB HID
features.desc: Human Interface Device class — used for custom input devices, sensor streams, and control panels.

features.name: USB MSC
features.desc: Mass Storage Class — Core appears as a USB drive; useful for datalogging and drag-and-drop firmware updates.

features.name: ROM DFU bootloader
features.desc: Uses the STM32 factory ROM bootloader to flash firmware over USB without a hardware debugger.

features.name: BLE advertising
features.desc: Broadcasts BLE advertisement packets — device discovery, beaconing, and connectionless data.

features.name: BLE GATT server
features.desc: Hosts a GATT service with characteristics that a central (phone, hub) can read, write, or subscribe to.

features.name: FDCAN
features.desc: CAN FD bus interface — industrial and automotive multi-device bus with up to 8 Mbit/s data rate.

features.name: I3C controller
features.desc: Next-gen sensor bus — I2C-compatible with higher speed, in-band interrupts, and dynamic addressing.

features.name: I3C target
features.desc: Core acts as an I3C secondary device, addressable by an external I3C controller.

features.name: COMP (analog comparator)
features.desc: Compares two voltages and outputs a digital signal or interrupt — threshold detection without ADC overhead.

features.name: DAC
features.desc: Digital-to-Analog Converter — generates a continuous analog voltage from a digital value.
